scope: 7 computational-gap targets (Families 11-15) + acrylamide safety target — literature-anchored barrier provenance.
methodology: Per-target consolidation of the active barrier (kcal/mol), confidence ceiling, refinability status, literature triangulation refs, and on-disk evidence paths. Unreliable xTB/DFT-derived values have been retired: hexanal_radical_quench (no literature anchor -> wet-lab pending), quinone_cys_michael (replaced by thiol-addition family surrogate). Asparagine-acrylamide uses Knol 2009 literature Ea directly.
global_decision: Scientific judgment on 2026-04-21: xTB/DFT values obtained for computational-gap targets were never accurate enough to carry as runtime anchors. Retired the xTB-derived numbers for hexanal_radical_quench and quinone_cys_michael; marked aa_ring_open_dicarbonyl as stack_limit_reached after two failed Sella-DFT recovery strategies; registered asparagine Ea from Knol 2009 directly. Diffusion-based TS generators (React-OT, OA-ReactDiff) could not be installed due to unresolved Python/torch-geometric/yarp dependency conflicts in maillard_validation; wrappers and tests were retired. Further refinement escalated to wet-lab backlog (Vía C).

targets.label: off-note lipid radical quench (hexanal H-abstraction)
targets.mechanism: H-abstraction by phenoxyl/thiyl radical from hexanal
targets.computational_method: No reliable anchor available. xTB-derived value (17.88 kcal/mol) retired 2026-04-21 because (i) GFN2 H-abstraction barriers for radical quench reactions are systematically biased and (ii) no direct literature Ea exists in repo for hexanal-quench by phenoxyl/thiyl radicals.
targets.refinability_note: Requires either: (a) hexanal H-abstraction Ea from radical-trapping literature ingestion, or (b) wet-lab measurement of hexanal suppression vs cysteine/sulfur partner concentration in oxidized-oil pre-cooking. See data/lit/deep_research_backlog.json for ResearchGate Ref 11 (lipid off-notes) ingestion.
targets.honest_label: Hexanal radical quench has no reliable kinetic anchor. Runtime falls back to literature_runtime barrier_kj_mol=31.72 default; treat any prediction qualitatively only.

targets.label: polyphenol o-quinone + Cys Michael addition
targets.computational_method: Literature family surrogate: thiol Michael addition to alpha,beta-unsaturated carbonyl (acrylamide-removal review, ResearchGate, ~29 kJ/mol). xTB-derived value was unreliable and has been retired.
targets.refinability_note: Direct ingestion of 13_polyphenol_amino_capping deep-research source (currently in deep_research_backlog) would close this gap with a primary measurement.
literature_refs: Thiol Michael addition family, ResearchGate acrylamide-removal review, ~29 kJ/mol
targets.honest_label: Family surrogate (Michael thiol addition, ~29 kJ/mol literature). Same mechanism class as o-quinone + Cys; bounded calibration, +/- factor 3-8.

targets.label: ascorbic-acid ring opening (stealth browning)
targets.computational_method: Family 14 HCW literature surrogate (bounded upstream dicarbonyl source)
targets.refinability_note: Family 14 selective-DFT closure attempted with two strategies (interpolation+xTB constrained relax, xTB-CI-NEB+TBLite). Sella DFT verdict: minimum on both seeds; mode-match score 0.78 / |omega|=193 cm-1 below acceptance gate. Stack limit reached for concerted multi-coordinate TS at GFN2-xTB seed quality. Surrogate retained as bounded_calibration; do not re-attempt without substantially improved seed (e.g., diffusion-based geometry generator with public CHON checkpoint that supports this composition).
literature_refs: HCW Family 14 surrogate (no DOI in repo)
targets.honest_label: HCW Family 14 surrogate for an upstream ascorbic-acid dicarbonyl source, DFT validation pending, ±factor 2-5; bounded calibration
